Position Summary

The DevOps Lead Engineer is responsible for leading the design, implementation, and optimization of scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This role drives infrastructure-as-code adoption, container orchestration, and observability practices while ensuring high system reliability and operational efficiency. The DevOps Lead Engineer mentors and guides DevOps team members, collaborates closely with engineering, security, and product teams, and embeds best practices in automation, governance, and cost optimization to support innovation and platform stability at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the design and implementation of scalable, resilient cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments

Architect, build, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps

Champion infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform, Ansible, or similar automation tools

Design and manage containerized environments using Docker and orchestrate workloads with Kubernetes or managed Kubernetes services

Establish and enhance monitoring, logging, and observability platforms using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or cloud-native monitoring solutions

Lead DevOps team members by providing technical guidance, mentorship, and performance support

Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, security, and product teams to streamline release cycles and improve deployment reliability

Implement and enforce cloud security best practices, governance standards, and compliance requirements

Drive cloud cost optimization strategies and infrastructure efficiency initiatives

Promote a culture of automation, reliability, and continuous improvement across platform and engineering teams

Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and deployment issues, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations

Contribute to documentation, standards development, and long-term platform architecture strategy

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)

  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering

  • Minimum 2 years in a leadership or team-lead capacity

  • Strong expertise in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

  • Deep experience with CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)

  • Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible)

  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and Kubernetes orchestration

  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)

  • Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)

  • Solid understanding of networking, cloud security best practices, and cost optimization strategies

  • Proven ability to lead technical teams and collaborate cross-functionally

  • Relevant cloud certifications preferred

Overview

Our organization is in hyper-growth mode, with 2026 lining up to be an outstanding year!

MasTec CE&I Services is now hiring a Mid- to Senior-Level Talent Acquisition Specialist, supporting our Infrastructure Construction market sector (Heavy Civil, Roadways, Bridges, Environmental Remediation), you will work closely with company leaders to anticipate and address the evolving needs of our workforce. Your primary responsibility will be to source and recruit top talent for both current and upcoming opportunities. This is an exciting chance to be involved in change management and the development of our new MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure Segment strategy.

Our team holds high expectations for ourselves and one another, driven by a passion for serving others. We operate within a complex organization and are currently experiencing significant growth. The ideal candidate will be self-driven, adaptable, and able to provide strategic direction on challenging recruitment initiatives. This is a full lifecycle recruitment role.

In this full-cycle recruitment role, agility in your recruitment approach is essential. We have a diverse range of positions to fill, including roles such as schedulers, project controls personnel, project managers, estimators, superintendents, construction managers, administrative support, and construction operational leaders, among others.

If this aligns with your skills and interests, we would love to hear from you!

Location & Travel Details: This is a remote position, which can be located anywhere in the continental United States. Must be able to work within regular business hours Monday-Friday between 7am-6pm of the applicable time zone. We offer all IT equipment, including a work cell phone or cell phone reimbursement. Preference given to candidates in the Southeast Region of the US, Central or Eastern time zones.

Company Overview

MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates more than $4.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across our operating groups: Renewables, Industrial, Infrastructure and General Building. Our Renewables expertise includes solar, wind, energy storage, aftermarket services, substations and switchyards. Our Industrial expertise includes manufacturing, mining and mineral processing, power plants, conventional power generation, alternative fuel generation and other innovative solutions. In Infrastructure, we specialize in electrical, environmental, highways, roads and bridges, aggregate mining, ports and terminals, rail, pump and lift stations, water transmission and pipelines, water and wastewater treatment plants, and stormwater. Our General Building expertise includes airports, seaport terminals, sports and entertainment, pre-engineered metal buildings, and data centers.

MasTec is a minority‑owned Fortune 500 construction company with more than 90 years of industry experience. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we deliver complex infrastructure projects across the country. Safety and sustainability are core to how we operate. MasTec is proudly ranked by Engineering News‑Record as #1 in Power, #16 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, and #13 Transportation Contractor.

We are experiencing rapid growth and offer opportunities to work on impactful projects while building long‑term careers. Our culture values development, innovation, and respect, empowering employees to grow their skills and help shape the future of the construction industry.

The Clean Energy & Infrastructure Group comprises the following market sectors and operating companies: Renewables: IEA Constructors, Wanzek Construction, White Construction; Industrial: Phoenix Industrial, MasTec Industrial; Infrastructure: American Civil Constructors West Coast, Cash Construction, FNF Construction, MasTec Civil, McKee Utility Contractors, Precision Aggregate Products, Ragnar Benson Construction, Saiia Construction, William Charles Construction, William Charles Electric; General Building: Lemartec, NV2A.

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for a Learning Experience Designer to join our B2B Curriculum team and develop technical / AI-focused courses for corporate clients. You will turn client needs and subject-matter expertise into practical, scalable learning experiences and continuously improve them using learner feedback and expert recommendations.

This is a full-time remote contract position. After the Online Introductory Call, candidates will be required to complete a test assignment.

What you will do

  • Own the end-to-end development of new B2B courses, from learning needs analysis and high-level design to final course documentation, in collaboration with Product Managers and subject-matter experts.
  • Build course Skill Trees and map learning outcomes across the course, modules, and individual lessons.
  • Create educational content, practice exercises, assessments, and learning aids based on materials provided by subject-matter experts.
  • Prepare clear briefs for designers and video editors, and develop outlines and facilitator materials for workshops, seminars, and other live formats.
  • Analyze each client’s learning needs, business goals, workflows, tools, operational constraints, and learner profiles together with Product Managers and client stakeholders.
  • Customize learning activities, case studies, learning paths, curriculum structure, and schedules to reflect authentic client tasks and the needs of different roles.
  • Continuously improve the learning experience by auditing cognitive load, motivation, difficulty, and alignment with learning outcomes; use learner feedback and expert recommendations to update content and maintain an improvement backlog.

Requirements

Must have:

  • At least three years of experience as an Instructional Designer, Learning Experience Designer, Learning Content Developer, Program Designer, or in a comparable role.
  • Proven experience applying modern learning experience design models, methodologies, and frameworks to the development of complex skills.
  • Experience structuring end-to-end learning experiences, including building Skill Trees and Learning Journey Maps and mapping learning outcomes.
  • Ability to create different forms of educational content, including long reads, projects, practice tasks, infographics, and other learning aids.
  • Experience designing and integrating skills and knowledge assessments into a course.
  • English proficiency at C1 level (strong B2 users with a good fit in other requirements are welcome to apply, too).

Nice to have:

  • Strong familiarity with popular AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Claude Design). Experience creating your own agents or workflows, or some familiarity with coding, is a strong plus.
  • Experience adapting curricula for B2B clients based on their business goals, workflows, learner profiles, and operational constraints.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, full-time collaboration.
  • Performance appraisals twice a year and a bonus system.
  • Digital office. We use modern digital tools like Miro, Notion, Slack, etc., to keep our teamwork smooth.
  • Have the freedom to work professionally. We trust your experience and don't believe in micromanaging.
  • Room to grow. Our product is expanding rapidly, so it's a great chance to join and challenge yourself.
  • Diverse and close-knit team. We're spread out across the world: Europe, Asia and Latin America.

Who We Are:

Therabody® is the wellness tech leader with a mission to inspire and enable everybody to feel, perform and look their best. Therabody’s product ecosystem includes category-creating innovations in wellness, performance and beauty products, proprietary software and digital content. Not only is it part of our brand ethos to help others, but we are also defining the cutting edge of wellness technology while winning accolades such as Fast Company’s Brands That Matter, Oprah's Favorite Things and the TIME Best Inventions 2025 award.

We’re committed to continuous innovation and surround ourselves with specialists, thought leaders, and experts - inside and outside of the office. If you thrive in creative environments, are concerned with big, innovative ideas, love to collaborate, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are driven to succeed, get in touch with us. Together we can push the limits of what can be achieved for everybody.

Who We’re Looking For:
We are seeking a Privacy Manager to serve as the critical liaison between Legal, Technology, Product, and Security teams. This role will ensure privacy requirements are translated into practical, scalable processes and technical implementations across the organization. The initial focus will be supporting our wearable technology initiatives, ensuring privacy is embedded into product development from design through deployment.

The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of privacy regulations with experience working alongside engineering and product teams to operationalize privacy programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Legal to interpret privacy laws, regulatory requirements, and company policies.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, IT, and Security teams to translate privacy requirements into technical and operational controls.
  • Lead privacy-by-design initiatives throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Serve as the primary privacy program manager for the wearable technology project, ensuring compliance is integrated into product architecture and workflows.
  • Conduct and facilitate Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs).
  • Develop, implement, and maintain privacy policies, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts to address privacy risks, remediation activities, and ongoing compliance initiatives.
  • Partner with Information Security on data governance, data classification, retention, and incident response activities.
  • Monitor changes in privacy laws and industry best practices, recommending updates to internal processes as needed.
  • Support vendor privacy reviews and third-party risk assessments.
  • Develop training and awareness programs to promote privacy compliance across the organization.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Legal Studies, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in privacy, information governance, compliance, cybersecurity, product management, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working across legal and technical teams to implement privacy requirements.
  • Working knowledge of major privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA (as applicable), and other emerging privacy laws.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills.
  • Ability to translate legal and regulatory language into actionable business and technical requirements.

Preferred

  • Professional certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, or Certified Information Privacy Manager
  • Experience supporting connected devices, IoT, digital health, wearable technology, or consumer technology products
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycles, cloud platforms, APIs, identity management, and data governance
  • Experience implementing Privacy by Design principles within Agile product development environments.

Key Competencies

  • Cross-functional leadership
  • Privacy program management
  • Regulatory compliance
  • Risk assessment
  • Stakeholder management
  • Technical communication
  • Process improvement
  • Data governance
  • Change management

Success Measures

  • Privacy requirements are incorporated into product development early in the lifecycle
  • Wearable technology initiatives launch with documented privacy controls and compliance assessments.
  • Privacy reviews are completed efficiently without delaying product delivery.
  • Cross-functional teams have clear ownership and operational processes for privacy compliance.
  • Privacy risks are proactively identified, documented, and mitigated.

Like all great companies, our success is a function of our people and our culture. Our employees have world-class talent, a collaborative work ethic, and a passion for the work that have earned us trusted advisor status among the world’s most recognized brands. As a member of the team, you will help us create value for our clients, you will make us better through your contribution to the work and your voice in the process. Ours is a path of learning and continuous improvement; team efforts chart the course for corporate success.

Our Mission:

We empower organizations to deliver the best experiences. With industry expertise and technology, we turn data into insights that drive innovation and action.

Our Values:

To put Human Experience at the heart of organizations so every person can be seen and understood.

  • Energize the customer relationship: Our clients are our partners. We make their goals our own, working side by side to turn challenges into solutions.

  • Success starts with me: Personal ownership fuels collective success. We each play our part and empower our teammates to do the same.

  • Commit to learning: Every win is a springboard. Every hurdle is a lesson. We use each experience as an opportunity to grow.

  • Dare to innovate: We challenge the status quo with creativity and innovation as our true north.

Nurses are the backbone of care delivery. Yet today, they face unprecedented pressures that strain teams and threaten quality. Our nursing consultants have lived these realities—leading teams, driving transformation, and redesigning care delivery. They help clients retain talent, elevate practice, and achieve sustainable nursing excellence. Our solutions reflect the day‑to‑day realities of nursing today and are designed to adapt to whatever tomorrow brings.

Location: Remote (U.S. based) or based in our Chicago, Boston, or South Bend hubs. For in‑office employees, we follow a hybrid schedule—Tuesdays through Thursdays in-office, with flexibility on other days depending on travel.

  • Leading preparation of client deliverables including data analyses, assessments, quality reviews, training, and presentations

  • Building and managing successful client relationships generating positive client feedback on quality, value, innovation, delivery, and results

  • Serving as the direct point of contact with the client and quickly establish credibility for the respective project work stream by proactively building strategic working relationships

  • Communicating effectively and appropriately influencing various audiences and levels of client management including risks and recommendations to project management

  • Planning, organizing and prioritizing project activities using work plans and other project management tools

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of nursing work with experience designing systems and processes.
  • Experience designing strategies that help nurses connect with those in their care.
  • Past experience in training and coaching nursing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience in driving performance improvement initiatives.
  • Requires strong data analytic skills (Excel, Access, SQL, SAS, etc.).
  • Advanced skills in MS Office Products (Word, PPT, Excel) to support document preparation.
  • Ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines and to quickly adapt to multiple priorities.
  • Experience working in a Magnet‑designated healthcare organization (per the ANCC Magnet Recognition Program®) with a focus on professional training, education or leadership development work is a strong plus.

Education

  • BSN required and an MSN preferred.

raw.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Director, Clinical Supervision & Practice Developmentis responsible foradvancing enterprise clinical supervision models, clinician competency frameworks, and practice development strategies that support consistent, high-quality clinical care across LifeStance. This role develops scalable supervision standards, supervisor training pathways, and outcomes-informed development practices by partnering with Clinical Practice, Measurement-Based Care, Clinical Operations, Learning & Development, Research, and clinical leadership. Success looks like enterprise-wide adoption of effective supervision practices, strengthened clinician capability, improved fidelity toevidence-based care, and measurable improvement in clinical quality, consistency, and patient outcomes.

Consistent withLifeStance’svalues, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may meanparticipatingin projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description. Leaders at LifeStance are expected to foster a commitment to the organization’s values.

Consistent withLifeStance’svalues, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may meanparticipatingin projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.

KEY RESPONSIBILITES 

The intent of this job description is to provide a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities performed by employees in this job. Employees may be requested to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description.

Clinical Supervision & Competency Leadership

  • Develop and operationalize enterprise clinical supervision standards, models, and expectations to support consistent and effective supervision across the organization.

  • Establish clinician competency expectations and performance development pathways that support clinician growth, evidence-based practice, and high-quality patient care.

  • Integrate measurement-based care, outcomes data, and quality insights into supervision practices toidentifyperformance gaps, guide clinician development, and support continuous improvement.

  • Partner with Clinical Practice, Measurement-Based Care, Clinical Operations, and clinical leadership to translate clinical standards andoutcomesinsights into meaningful improvements in clinician performance.

  • Advance supervision approaches for specialty populations, programs, and emerging therapies to ensure effective application of required clinical skills and competencies in practice.

Education, Training & Professional Development

  • Partner with Learning & Development to design scalable supervisor training, coaching, assessment, and certification pathways aligned to enterprise supervision and competency expectations.

  • Support the development of training, education, implementation, and certification resources related to evidence-based practice, specialty care, outcomes-informed treatment, and therapeutic competency development.

  • Foster professional growth through advanced learning opportunities, consultation, and mentorship for clinical leaders and supervisors.

  • Support leadership development initiatives that strengthen clinical supervision, clinical excellence, and organizational performance.

Practice Development, Research & Thought Leadership

  • Collaborate with Research teams to supportoutcomesstudies, publications, presentations, and other scholarly activities that advance understanding of treatment effectiveness and supervision impact.

  • Partner with Information Technology, Clinical Operations, and external partners to evaluate emerging therapeutic models and innovative tools that enhance clinical capability, therapeutic fidelity, and clinical insight.

  • Serve as a thought leader through participation in professional conferences, speaking engagements, industry collaborations, and external partnerships.

  • Contribute to enterprise practice development strategies that supportLifeStance’sclinical excellence, measurement-based care, clinician development, and value-based care readiness goals.

REQUIREMENTS

Scope / Decision-Making / Impact

This role influences enterprise clinical supervision standards, clinician competency expectations, supervisor development pathways, and outcomes-informed practice improvement strategies across a large, multi-state outpatient behavioral health organization. The role is expected to make recommendationsregardingsupervision models, competency frameworks, training priorities, clinical development resources, and performance improvement approaches. Decisions involving enterprise risk, material operational change, budget commitments, or policy-level implications are escalated to senior leadership asappropriate.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role may directly supervise team members, contractors, or matrixed contributors as the clinical supervision and practice development function evolves. If the role does not initially have direct reports, it is still expected to provide leadership, coaching, and direction to cross-functional partners and contributors supporting supervision, training, and practice development initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Advanced clinical degree, such as Clinical Psychology PhD, PsyD, or equivalent clinical training and experience.

  • Active professional license in good standing, as applicable to the candidate’s discipline and the work performed.

  • 7–10+ years of experience in clinical supervision, clinical training, therapist development, clinical leadership, psychotherapy practice standards, or related behavioral health leadership roles.

  • Demonstratedexpertisein evidence-based psychotherapy modalities, such as CBT, DBT, trauma-informed care, exposure-based treatments, or other evidence-based therapeutic approaches.

  • Experience developing, implementing, or scaling clinical supervision models, competency frameworks, professional development programs, or supervisor training pathways.

  • Strong ability to translate clinical evidence, outcomes data, measurement-based care insights, and best practices into scalable supervision standards, training resources, and clinician development strategies.

  • Experience working with clinical operations or cross-functional teams to support implementation of care models, clinical standards, or practice improvement initiatives.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with clinical, operational, executive, and external audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across matrixed teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Essential Competencies

  • Expertisein competency-based education, clinical supervision models, clinician development, and performance improvement.

  • Strong understanding of evidence-based psychotherapy, fidelity to therapeutic models,supervisionbest practices, and outcomes-informed care.

  • Ability to use measurement-based care and performance data toidentifydevelopment needs, guide supervision priorities, and support continuous improvement.

  • Strong coaching, mentorship, consultation, and leadership development skills.

  • Systems thinker with the ability to scale supervision and clinician development practices across a large, complex organization.

  • Skilled in driving adoption, behavior change, and practice improvement across clinical teams.

  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to contribute to publications, presentations, clinical resources, and executive-ready materials.

  • High standardsfor clinical quality, patient safety, ethics, equity, privacy, and compliance.

  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status,disability,or any other legally protectedstatus.

  • Demonstratesawareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects ofculture.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Experience in a large, multi-site, multi-state behavioral health, outpatient mental health, or healthcare delivery organization.

  • Experience integrating measurement-based care, outcomes data, or quality metrics into clinical supervision or clinician development practices.

  • Familiarity withimplementationscience, behavior change frameworks, quality improvement methods, or care model implementation.

  • Experience contributing to research, publications, professional presentations, clinical thought leadership, or external-facing clinical excellence initiatives.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depthperceptionand the ability to adjust focus.

  • This role is primarily performed in a remote office or similar indoor environment, requiring reliable internet access and a quiet, distraction-free, dedicated workspaceappropriate forconfidential work. Work involves extended periods of sitting, frequent computer use, audio/video calls, meetings, writing, content review, data review, and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Chief API Officer (CAPIO) is responsible for establishing and executing the organization's Application Programming Interface (API) strategy, governance, and ecosystem development initiatives. This executive leads API product management, developer experience, platform integration, Open Banking/Open Finance initiatives, API monetization, security, and digital ecosystem expansion. The role serves as the bridge between business strategy and technology innovation, ensuring APIs become strategic assets that drive revenue, partnerships, customer engagement, and digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the enterprise-wide API strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Establish APIs as strategic products and revenue-generating assets.
  • Drive API-first and platform-centric business models across the organization.
  • Identify opportunities for ecosystem expansion through API enablement.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on API innovation and digital ecosystem trends.

API Product Management

  • Oversee the API lifecycle from design and development to deployment and retirement.
  • Define API product roadmaps and service portfolios.
  • Ensure APIs meet customer, developer, and partner requirements.
  • Drive adoption of API product management best practices.
  • Establish service-level agreements (SLAs) and performance standards.

API Governance & Architecture

  • Develop API governance frameworks, standards, and policies.
  • Establish enterprise API architecture and design principles.
  • Ensure consistency, scalability, and interoperability across API platforms.
  • Oversee API versioning, documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Promote API reuse and enterprise integration strategies.

Developer Ecosystem & Partnerships

  • Build and manage developer communities and partner ecosystems.
  • Develop API onboarding programs and developer support initiatives.
  • Foster innovation through open APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Collaborate with external developers, fintechs, vendors, and strategic partners.
  • Lead developer experience (DX) improvements.

API Monetization & Commercial Strategy

  • Develop API monetization models and pricing strategies.
  • Create new revenue streams through API products and services.
  • Identify commercial partnership opportunities leveraging APIs.
  • Monitor API usage, consumption trends, and profitability.
  • Support marketplace and ecosystem expansion strategies.

Open Banking & Open Finance Leadership

  • Lead Open Banking, Open Finance, and Embedded Finance API initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive innovation through financial data-sharing ecosystems.
  • Develop strategic API partnerships with financial institutions and fintech organizations.

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure API security and data protection standards are maintained.
  • Oversee authentication, authorization, and access management frameworks.
  • Implement API cybersecurity best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage operational, security, and third-party risks.

Technology & Innovation

  • Drive adoption of modern API technologies and integration platforms.
  • Oversee API gateways, management platforms, and developer portals.
  • Support cloud-native architectures and microservices transformation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies including AI, blockchain, and event-driven architectures.
  • Promote continuous innovation and automation.

Data & Analytics

  • Monitor API performance and business outcomes.
  • Establish API analytics and reporting frameworks.
  • Utilize data insights to optimize API products and customer experiences.
  • Measure ecosystem growth and API adoption metrics.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead high-performing API product, engineering, architecture, and developer relations teams.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer-centricity.
  • Develop future leaders and technical experts within the API organization.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree preferred.

Experience

  • 12+ years of leadership experience in API management, enterprise architecture, digital platforms, software engineering, fintech, or technology sectors.
  • Proven experience developing and managing enterprise API ecosystems.
  • Strong background in Open Banking, Open Finance, platform strategies, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading large-scale integration and developer ecosystem programs.

Technical Knowledge

  • API Design & Architecture
  • REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and Event-Driven APIs
  • API Gateways & Management Platforms
  • Open Banking & Open Finance Standards
  • Cloud Computing & Microservices
  • Enterprise Integration
  • Cybersecurity & Identity Management
  • Developer Portals & Developer Experience
  • Data Governance & Privacy
  • Platform & Ecosystem Management

Core Competencies

  • API Strategy & Governance
  • Platform & Ecosystem Development
  • API Product Management
  • Digital Transformation Leadership
  • API Monetization
  • Developer Experience (DX)
  • Security & Risk Management
  • Innovation & Emerging Technologies
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Executive Leadership

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • API adoption and consumption growth.
  • API revenue and monetization performance.
  • Number of active developers and partners.
  • API platform uptime and reliability.
  • Time-to-market for API products.
  • Security and compliance performance.
  • Customer and developer satisfaction scores.
  • API transaction volume growth.
  • Ecosystem expansion metrics.
  • Operational efficiency and cost optimization.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in UX/UI design for complex B2B, enterprise, or data-heavy platforms
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX work across research, interaction design, and high-fidelity execution
  • Proven experience designing complex systems, dashboards, or analytics-driven applications
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and modern design systems
  • Experience leading user research initiatives and translating insights into shipped product improvements
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders

raw.description:
Overview

Reporting to the Director of Healthcare Compliance, the Senior Compliance Coding Auditor is responsible for conducting independent coding, billing, documentation, and regulatory compliance audits across ambulatory and specialty care practices. The position supports the organization's compliance program through risk-based auditing, monitoring, provider education, investigation of billing concerns, identification of revenue integrity risks, and development of corrective action plans. The Senior Compliance Coding Auditor serves as a subject matter expert for professional fee coding, documentation requirements, government and commercial payer regulations, and healthcare compliance standards. This role partners closely with physicians, advanced practice providers, practice leadership, revenue cycle, coding, clinical operations, and executive leadership to promote compliant billing and documentation practices.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions:

Auditing and Monitoring

•Conduct retrospective and targeted prospective compliance coding audits (i.e. baseline, routine periodic, monitoring, and focused) of professional services

•Review medical record documentation to validate CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, modifier assignment, medical necessity, and payer specific billing requirements

•Identify coding, documentation, billing, and compliance risks and develop recommendations for improvement

•Evaluate compliance with CMS, Medicare Administrative Contractor (MAC), Medicaid, and commercial payer regulations

•Conduct specialty specific audits including procedural, surgical, and evaluation and management (E/M) services

•Review provider documentation for completeness, accuracy, and support of services billed

•Monitor corrective action plans and validate effectiveness of remediation efforts

•Participate in annual compliance risk assessments and coding audit plan development

•Analyze audit findings and identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for focused monitoring activities

•Work closely with all departments, including but not limited to, Clinical Services, Nursing, Practice Leadership, Finance, IT, Training, Rev Cycle, and Billing to assist in accuracy of reported services and with chart reviews, as requested. Provider and Coding Education and Consultation

• Communicate audit findings and recommendations to physicians, advanced practice providers, coders, leadership, and operational teams

• Develop and deliver coding and compliance education programs for providers, coders, and staff

• Provide ongoing guidance regarding: o CPT and HCPCS coding o ICD-10-CM diagnosis coding o E/M documentation requirements o Modifier utilization o Medical necessity documentation requirements o Specialty specific coding and billing guidelines

• Serve as a subject matter expert resource for regulatory and payer-related coding questions

• Work with the purchasing department to order and distribute annual coding materials for all clinical sites and departments.

Compliance Program Support

• Support implementation and maintenance of the organization’s compliance coding auditing and monitoring program

• Participate in policy development and revision related to coding and billing compliance

• Collaborate with Revenue Cycle, Clinical Operations, Quality, Information Technology, Credentialing, Finance, and Legal teams as necessary to facilitate compliant coding and billing practices

• Advise organization of government coding and billing guidelines and regulatory updates

• Assist with investigations involving coding, billing, documentation, and reimbursement concerns.

• Monitor regulatory updates and assess organizational impact.

• Support compliance initiatives related to: o Medicare and Medicaid billing regulations o Commercial payer requirements o OIG compliance guidance o Documentation integrity o Revenue integrity

EHR and Documentation Intergrity

• Participate in the development and enhancement of EHR templates and programming and advise on coding compliance with payor guidelines. Reporting

• Report findings and recommendations to compliance and leadership.

• Prepare written audit reports, executive summaries, dashboards, and compliance metrics.

• Present audit results and recommendations to leadership and designated committees.

• Maintain documentation supporting audit methodologies, findings, and corrective action activities. Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Advanced knowledge and demonstrated proficiency in the application of ICD-10-CM, CPT®, and HCPCS Level II coding guidelines, conventions, and regulatory requirements.
  • Extensive knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy and physiology, disease processes, pharmacology, and clinical documentation requirements.
  • Thorough understanding of Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) regulations, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, Office of Inspector General (OIG) compliance guidance, Medicare and Medicaid policies, and applicable payer-specific coding and billing requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare compliance programs, auditing methodologies, reimbursement principles, and revenue integrity practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct complex coding and documentation audits, identify compliance risks, determine root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ability to analyze coding, billing, and audit data; identify trends and patterns; and develop actionable recommendations for process improvement and risk mitigation
  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to educate providers, leadership, and staff on coding, documentation, and compliance requirements.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reporting.
  • Experience utilizing electronic health records (EHRs), coding systems, auditing software, and compliance monitoring tools.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with clinical, operational, revenue cycle, and compliance stakeholders to support organizational compliance and revenue integrity objectives.
  • Ability to interpret and apply evolving regulatory guidance, coding updates, and industry best practices to ensure organizational compliance and revenue integrity.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Associates Degree (higher degree accepted)

Required Work Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in professional coding with demonstrated expert knowledge of procedural and diagnostic coding.
  • Minimum of 2 years of coding audit experience, including provider education, documentation review, and evaluation of coding accuracy and regulatory compliance.
  • Advanced knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT®, HCPCS Level II, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, Medicare Physician Fee Schedule, and applicable payer-specific billing and coding requirements.
  • Extensive knowledge of federal and state healthcare compliance requirements, reimbursement methodologies, documentation standards, and audit processes.

Require License and Ceritifcations:

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC®) through AAPC

The Electric Utility – Engineering/Technical Support role is a key strategic partner to the Vice President, Electric Utilities and plays a critical role in enabling the successful integration of our client’s data center developments into regional power systems. This position oversees the full electric load-interconnection process, serves as the client’s primary liaison with utilities and market operators, and ensures that transmission, distribution, and power‑delivery requirements are thoroughly evaluated and optimized to support near‑ and long‑term growth.

This role combines technical depth with cross-functional leadership, helping the organization navigate complex utility interfaces, assess grid readiness, develop business cases, and communicate technical considerations to non-technical stakeholders. The Electric Utility – Engineering/Technical Support professional also contributes to broader corporate initiatives—including process improvement, market assessment, power procurement strategy, and regulatory engagement—to support the expansion across diverse markets.

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

Utility Integration & Project Support

  • Manage the end-to-end utility load-interconnection process for all assigned development projects.
  • Serve as the primary interface with electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and transmission operators, fostering strong, collaborative relationships.
  • Review and evaluate utility system-impact studies, load-flow models, and power-delivery feasibility assessments.
  • Oversee third-party engineering and consultant studies to ensure technical accuracy, risk mitigation, and alignment with project objectives.
  • Support transmission planning needs by evaluating grid capacity, upgrade requirements, and long‑term infrastructure implications for new and existing sites.

Strategic Decision Support

  • Assess new market viability from a utility and transmission-delivery perspective and provide recommendations to cross-functional leadership.
  • Analyze utility constraints, risks, and opportunities to inform site-selection and development strategies.
  • Communicate complex engineering concepts, utility timelines, and technical issues clearly and effectively to non-technical executives and stakeholders.

Contract, Budget & Process Management

  • Review, negotiate, and provide technical input on utility service agreements, interconnection contracts, and power-delivery provisions.
  • Develop and maintain project-level utility budget forecasts, including interconnection costs, upgrades, and long-term O&M considerations.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to optimize coordination with utilities, engineering partners, and internal teams.

Corporate & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with development, engineering, supply chain, policy, energy procurement, legal, and leadership teams to advance project objectives.
  • Contribute to corporate initiatives related to energy strategy, regulatory engagement, new market exploration, and long-term planning.
  • Support the preparation of business cases, executive summaries, and leadership approvals related to utility strategy and project feasibility.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in electric utility engineering, grid planning, interconnection management, or equivalent technical role.
  • Strong understanding of transmission and distribution systems, interconnection processes, and ISO/RTO operations.
  • Proven ability to manage complex technical projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical information for diverse audiences.
  • Experience in data center, large industrial load, or utility-scale energy projects is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with utilities, consultants, and internal teams.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

LMI is seeking a senior-level Solution Architect to support Army Acquisition, Training, and Readiness (AT&R) and provide technical leadership for the sustainment and enhancement of the Army Contract Writing System (ACWS). ACWS is built on the Appian Platform and supports the Army Contracting Enterprise. The Solution Architect will lead end-to-end solution architecture, integration, and technical decision-making across application, cloud, data, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, testing, and user-facing capabilities.

The successful candidate will bridge strategic architecture and Agile delivery, guide technical teams through architecture runway and solution refinement, and ensure ACWS capabilities remain secure, scalable, interoperable, and maintainable in a mission-critical Army environment.

  • Define and maintain the end-to-end solution architecture for ACWS, aligning technical direction with program objectives, user needs, and delivery priorities.
  • Lead solution-level architecture across the Appian application stack, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, data architecture, integrations, test automation, and DevSecOps capabilities.
  • Serve as a senior technical design authority and primary architectural interface for government stakeholders, program leadership, and delivery teams.
  • Ensure seamless integration among ACWS application components, shared services, data sources, interfaces, security services, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Guide architectural runway, technical feasibility assessments, nonfunctional requirements, and architecture-related enablers needed for continuous delivery.
  • Participate in Agile and SAFe ceremonies, including PI Planning, architecture syncs, solution refinement, system demos, and retrospectives, as appropriate to the program.
  • Create and maintain architecture artifacts and technical documentation consistent with Army and DoD standards and approved program practices.
  • Provide guidance on secure cloud deployment, identity and access management, application security, resilience, performance, and scalability.
  • Partner with developers, Appian specialists, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, information assurance personnel, testers, and functional SMEs to resolve architectural issues and delivery risks.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, Appian capabilities, and architectural patterns and recommend practical improvements to ACWS sustainability, usability, security, and maintainability.
  • Prepare and deliver technical briefings, architecture recommendations, and decision materials to program stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Support production troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex cross-system issues and drive architecture-level corrective actions.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; extensive relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 9+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, large-scale system integration, software engineering, or technical leadership of complex systems.
  • Experience serving as a Solution Architect or equivalent senior architecture role supporting a Federal Government, DoD, or other mission-critical enterprise system.
  • Experience designing integrated solutions spanning application architecture, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, DevSecOps, and testing.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments and collaborating across multidisciplinary technical and functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and architecture decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Active Secret clearance.
  • U.S. citizenship required.

DESIRED SKILLS

  • SAFe Solution Architect certification or equivalent, or ability to obtain.
  • AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or Professional.
  • Experience with the Appian Platform, with Appian architecture or Appian-based enterprise application experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting Army or DoD contract writing, acquisition, or other large-scale business process systems.
  • Familiarity with DoD architecture and cybersecurity frameworks such as DoDAF, RMF, and related security requirements.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience aligning technical roadmaps and architectural runway with Agile Release Train or Solution Train delivery.

raw.description:
Overview

As a Cloud Architect, you will work within our growing DevSecOps practice delivering features to support cloud migration, cloud optimization, and cloud deployment on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role is responsible for the design, standards, and architectural direction of GCP environments supporting mission-critical, regulated workloads.

We are looking for candidates with 8-10 years of experience with GCP platform services and DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code and configuration management automation, and deep, hands-on architectural ownership of enterprise GCP landing zones.

Contributions

  • Identify and implement the most optimal GCP-based solutions for the customer
  • Design GCP cloud environments and demonstrate technical architectural knowledge, playing a vital role in the design of production, staging, QA, and development infrastructures running in 24×7 environments
  • Architect and own GCP Landing Zone Architectures, GCP Terraform Foundations, and Organizational Policies, incorporating guardrails and standards established by leadership
  • Design hybrid connectivity architecture, including Cloud Interconnect
  • Design DNS architecture, including Cloud DNS, Private Zones, and hybrid DNS resolution
  • Design VPC-level networking architecture and standards, including Shared VPC architecture and VPC firewall rules
  • Implement and oversee cloud strategies including migrations and optimization
  • Establish development tools and infrastructure for automation
  • Understand the needs of stakeholders and convey this to developers and engineers
  • Automate and improve development, testing, deployment, and release processes using Cloud Build, Cloud Deploy, Artifact Registry, and Cloud Source Repositories, Cloud Run functions, and infrastructure as code
  • Test and examine code written by others and analyze results
  • Perform root cause analysis on complex business processes and technical components
  • Ensure that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats, leveraging Security Command Center and NIST 800-53/FedRAMP/FISMA control frameworks
  • Identify technical problems, perform root cause analysis, and develop software updates and fixes
  • Work with software developers and software engineers to ensure that development follows established processes and works as intended
  • Support enterprise cloud applications and infrastructure through infrastructure as code, including automated server and network configurations, large-scale software deployments, and monitoring and testing (CI/CD)
  • Document the as-is state of the environment, perform gap analysis, and produce artifacts that articulate options and recommendations
  • Leverage virtualization and containerization to optimize and modernize software systems
  • Act as an individual contributor and provide technical mentorship on best practices
  • Engineer and implement solutions and provide recommendations for continuous improvement of the services provided
  • Present regular status updates and provide cross-training to other team members

Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in an IT-related field, or a bachelor’s degree in a non-IT field with at least 2 years of related IT experience.
  • 10+ years of overall professional experience.
  • 8+ years of experience architecting, designing, developing, and implementing cloud solutions.
  • 8+ years of experience with systems development in an Agile environment.
  • 5+ years of experience implementing proof-of-concept (POC) or minimum viable product (MVP) solutions and participating in sprint demonstrations.
  • 5+ years of experience across several of the following areas: database architecture, ETL, business intelligence, big data, machine learning, and advanced analytics.
  • 8+ years of experience using Git source control management (SCM) platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
  • 8+ years of experience implementing infrastructure as code (IaC) and orchestration.
  • 8+ years of experience integrating deployments with industry-standard DevSecOps tooling and orchestration.
  • Hands-on experience with GCP technologies and related tools, including:
    • GCP Landing Zone architectures
    • GCP Terraform Foundations
    • Terraform and Terragrunt
    • Organizational policies
    • Cloud Build and Cloud Deploy
    • Artifact Registry
    • Cloud Source Repositories
    • Cloud Interconnect, Cloud DNS, Private Zones, and hybrid DNS management
    • VPC firewall rule administration
    • Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring
    • Security Command Center
    • Cloud Run functions
    • Cloud Storage
    • BigQuery
    • Google Workspace administration and identity management
    • Google Cloud Directory Services
    • Shared VPC architecture and hub-and-spoke networking
    • Python scripting
    • Networking, including IPv6
  • Experience implementing or operating within environments subject to NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, and FISMA requirements.
  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification (current or previously held).

Preferred

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience documenting the as-is state of an environment, performing gap analyses, and developing artifacts that articulate options and recommendations.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Bash, PowerShell, Python, Groovy, or Ruby.
  • Experience implementing Docker containers and working with platforms such as Kubernetes.
  • Experience with automation tools, including Terraform, Terragrunt, or Ansible.

raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Senior Data Scientist will support the Defense Health Agency (DHA) Revenue Cycle Operating System (RevOS) initiative by designing and implementing advanced analytics, statistical models, predictive capabilities, and decision-support visualizations within a Databricks-based environment.
raw.description:
Overview

The Senior Data Scientist will support the Defense Health Agency (DHA) Revenue Cycle Operating System (RevOS) initiative by designing and implementing advanced analytics, statistical models, predictive capabilities, and decision-support visualizations within a Databricks-based environment.

The role will focus on transforming complex healthcare, financial, coding, claims, payment, and operational data into actionable intelligence that enables DHA to identify revenue leakage, coding and charge-capture errors, denied or stalled claims, underpayments, aged receivables, and opportunities to recover revenue.

The Senior Data Scientist will work closely with Data Engineers, Revenue Cycle SMEs, DHA stakeholders, and product leadership to develop analytics aligned to the end-to-end revenue-cycle workflow:

Scheduling → Eligibility → Registration → Authorization → Patient Care → Documentation → Coding → Charge Capture → Claims → Adjudication → Remittance → Denials → Collections / Recovery

The objective is not simply to produce reports. The role will help create analytical products and Databricks-based dashboards that identify where revenue-cycle processes are failing, quantify financial impact, prioritize corrective action, and measure recovery.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop advanced analytics within Databricks using Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, statistical methods, and machine-learning techniques.
  • Develop Databricks visualizations, Databricks SQL dashboards, AI/BI dashboards, and related native visualization capabilities to provide operational and executive visibility into RevOS performance.
  • Create interactive dashboards supporting DHA J-8, DHN, MTF, revenue-cycle, coding, financial, and executive users.
  • Translate analytical models into intuitive visualizations showing financial exposure, recovery opportunity, trends, root causes, outliers, and recommended operational priorities.
  • Develop command-level RevOS SITREP dashboards using Healthy / At Risk / Critical indicators across the Front, Middle, and Back Office revenue cycle.
  • Develop drill-down analytics from enterprise and DHN levels through MTF, department, provider, encounter, claim, and claim-line levels.
  • Design and develop analytical models that identify and quantify potential revenue leakage and recovery opportunities.
  • Analyze encounter, documentation, coding, charge, claim, denial, adjudication, payment, and accounts-receivable data to identify patterns associated with lost or delayed revenue.
  • Develop detection logic for:
  • Missing or incomplete charges
  • Uncoded and delayed encounters
  • Coding inconsistencies and potential coding errors
  • Claims-readiness defects
  • Denied and rejected claims
  • Underpayments and unexplained payment variances
  • Unmatched or unposted remittances
  • Aged claims and receivables
  • Eligibility and authorization failures
  • Develop recoverability and priority-scoring models based on financial value, probability of recovery, aging, filing/appeal deadlines, and operational severity.
  • Develop payer-performance and denial analytics to identify recurring payer behaviors, denial patterns, reimbursement variances, and process failures.
  • Build predictive models that identify revenue-cycle failures before they result in lost revenue or excessive Days-to-Bill.
  • Establish baselines and anomaly-detection methodologies across Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office processes.
  • Design financial-impact methodologies that estimate potentially recoverable revenue while maintaining separation between analytical estimates and official accounting determinations.
  • Develop and validate standardized RevOS KPIs and analytical measures.
  • Support development of the RevOS Revenue Opportunity Ledger, including estimated recoverable amount, recoverability score, priority score, root cause, and recommended next action.
  • Create dashboard views that allow users to move from aggregate metrics into the underlying Revenue Opportunity Ledger and actionable work queues.
  • Partner with Data Engineers to ensure Silver and Gold structures support analytical, visualization, and dashboard performance requirements.
  • Optimize analytical queries and calculations used by Databricks dashboards to support responsive enterprise-scale visualization.
  • Validate that models, KPIs, and dashboard calculations reconcile to authoritative source records.
  • Develop analytical data products supporting coding audit, payer scoring, denial management, revenue recovery, financial reconciliation, and audit remediation.
  • Document model purpose, features, methodology, validation, performance, refresh cadence, limitations, and version history.
  • Support model monitoring, validation, retraining, and ModelOps practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, quantitative analysis, machine learning, or related disciplines.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks.
  • Demonstrated ability to use Databricks native visualization and dashboard capabilities, including Databricks SQL and/or AI/BI dashboards.
  • Experience designing operational, analytical, and executive dashboards based on large enterprise datasets.
  • Advanced proficiency with Python and SQL.
  • Experience with Spark/PySpark or comparable distributed-computing technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience developing predictive models, anomaly detection, classification, prioritization/scoring models, or similar analytical capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of feature engineering, model validation, statistical testing, and analytical quality assurance.
  • Experience working with complex financial, operational, healthcare, claims, payment, or transactional data.
  • Ability to translate business and operational problems into measurable analytical hypotheses and production-ready analytical products.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex analytical findings through visualizations and dashboards to both technical and non-technical users.
  • Experience developing KPIs that reconcile to authoritative data sources.
  • Understanding of modern lakehouse and Bronze / Silver / Gold architectures.
  • Ability to work with Data Engineers and Architects to define data structures required for analytics and visualization.
  • Experience developing auditable and explainable analytical methodologies appropriate for financial or regulated environments.
  • Ability to operate within Agile product-development and iterative delivery environments.
  • Ability to meet applicable DHA/DoD security, privacy, access, and data-handling requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience with Advana and/or the current War Data Platform (WDP).
  • Experience developing dashboards and analytical products within a DoD Databricks environment.
  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, MLflow, Workflows, or related capabilities.
  • Healthcare revenue-cycle experience, including coding, claims, charge capture, denials, AR, remittance, payer reimbursement, and underpayment analysis.
  • Familiarity with healthcare payer transaction data such as 835, 837, 270/271, 276/277, and 278 transactions.
  • Experience with MHS GENESIS, Oracle Health/Cerner Millennium, Abacus, or similar healthcare systems.
  • Experience supporting federal financial management, audit remediation, or revenue-recognition initiatives.
  • Familiarity with certified data products, lineage, data governance, and data-quality controls.
  • Experience developing explainable AI/ML capabilities in regulated or Government environments.

Target salary range: $140,375 - $185,604. Final compensation will be determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to your skills, experience, education, and/or certifications.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

US-Remote

Our company

OUR COMPANY

The work environment

A Global Clinical Leader in Dermatology and rheumatology!

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

﻿Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Become a part of our caring community

Make a meaningful difference for mothers, babies, and families across Illinois. As a Care Coordinator Doula, you'll help support Humana's IL Medicaid members throughout their pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum journey. Working with a multidisciplinary team of nurses, social workers, behavioral health professionals, and care coordinators, you'll help ensure members receive compassionate, personalized care that improves health outcomes and addresses barriers to care. This is an opportunity to combine your doula expertise with care coordination, advocacy, and community engagement to positively affect the lives of families during one of their most important life experiences.

The Care Coordinator Doula's responsibilities include:

  • Ensure pregnant and postpartum Medicaid members are receiving appropriate services in the least restrictive setting to achieve and/or maintain optimal well-being by assessing their care needs.
  • Identify and resolve barriers that hinder effective perinatal and postpartum care.
  • Plan and implement interventions to meet care needs.
  • Coordinate services, monitor, and evaluate the case management plan against the member's personal goals.
  • Ensure the member is progressing towards desired outcomes by continuously monitoring through use of assessment, data, conversations with members, and active care planning.
  • Assess and evaluate members' needs via telephonic and face-to-face assessments and evaluations, to coordinate services and address enrollee needs.
  • Assist members to remediate immediate and acute gaps in care and access.
  • Provide information to enrollee related to MCO requirements, services, and benefits.
  • Provide enrollee with information and/or referrals to community resources.
  • Guide members/families towards resources appropriate for their care. Services are driven by facilitating interactions with other payer sources, providers, interdisciplinary teams, and others involved in the member's care as appropriate and required by our comprehensive contract.
  • Visit Medicaid members in their residences – up to 25% local travel


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Illinois Medicaid-Certified Doula
  • Must reside in Illinois.
  • 1+ years of experience in health care.
  • 1+ years of case management/care coordination experience.
  • Intermediate to advanced computer skills and experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Experience using a variety of electronic information applications/software programs including electronic medical records.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Medicaid recipients.
  • Experience providing doula services to individuals and families during pregnancy, childbirth, and the postpartum period.
  • Knowledge of community health and social service agencies and additional community resources.
  • Previous managed care experience.
  • Bilingual.

Additional Information

  • Workstyle: This is a remote position that will require you to travel.
  • Travel: Up to 25% local travel for collaboration and face-to-face meetings as well as field interactions with staff, providers, members, and their families.
  • Typical work days/hours: Operating hours areMonday - Friday 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM CST but core hours for this position are primarily Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST. May need to be flexible with work schedule based on business needs.

Driving

This role is part of Humana's driver safety program and therefore requires an individual to have a valid state driver's license and are expected to maintain personal vehicle liability insurance. Individual must carry vehicle insurance in accordance with their residing state minimum required limits, or $25,000 bodily injury per person/$25,000 bodily injury per event /$10,000 for property damage or whichever is higher.

TB

This role is considered patient facing and is part of Humana's Tuberculosis (TB) screening program. If selected for this role, you will be required to be screened for TB.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$53,700 - $72,600 per year

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.
