raw.excerpt: Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need youSpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars.
raw.description:
Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: the Live HCP Engagement Platform that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn live events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

Pharma companies use event platforms as registration forms while request, approval, budget, HCP registration, transfer of value (ToV), and reporting run in Excel and at agencies. We are building Onomi 360, the life-sciences strategic meetings management (SMM) product, to replace the incumbent event platform in that space. First accounts already run their meeting requests and approvals in Onomi 360; the demand is validated and the trajectory is exciting.

Your focus will be MeetingsEQ, the SMM layer of Onomi 360: one front door for every request, approval and budget as configuration, unified HCP identity, per-attendee ToV allocation, and engagement and spend flowing back into the CRM without re-keying. The customer's CRM and master data stay where they are; the event platform behind the meetings program is where we play. AI-assisted development is how we work, and you will have real freedom to use it.

This position is the ideal role for a hands-on product leader from the life-sciences meetings, compliance, or HCP-data world who would rather ship and test than talk about the problem, and who wants to own one product end to end and see the process they once operated replaced with a modern, AI-first workflow.

As a Senior Product Manager, Onomi 360, you will be reporting to the VP Product. Your time will be spent on:

  • [35%] Defining the detailed product. Turn customer workbooks, operating procedures, RFP requirements, and our capability map into roadmap priorities and build-ready specifications.
  • [30%] Shipping. Work daily with design and engineering in the Onomi 360 codebase: thin production slices, prototypes, scope calls, validation in the running product. Daily AI-based prototyping and customer validation.
  • [25%] Customers and partners. Work with meetings operations, compliance, medical affairs, finance, agencies, and the customer’s data team. Define how Onomi 360 works with Veeva, Salesforce, Snowflake, and consent, and own the venue-sourcing and fair-market-value partner integrations.
  • [10%] Product truth. Keep what we claim, what we demo, and what we ship documented, clear and moving in the right direction.

Objectives - The problems you will solve

In your first month, you will:

  • Take over the first customer’s move from their meeting request form to Onomi 360: spec, build, history migration, customer session.
  • Get set up with AI-based toolkit and the Onomi 360 codebase, and use both in your daily work.
  • Meet the early access customers (design partners) for Onomi 360.

After 3 months, you will have:

  • The first customer live on meeting request and approvals in Onomi 360, measured against their baseline.
  • The roadmap priorities for the next two quarters defined, and the first priorities specified to build depth with engineering.
  • A clean separation everyone uses: aspirational (slides), forward-looking (prototype-based demo), and committed (roadmap and backlog).

After 6 months, you will have:

  • The full end-to-end MeetingsEQ product specified and engineering-reviewed, request through approval, budget, HCP registration, ToV, and reporting.
  • One customer replacing Excel with the Onomi 360 ToV module, and the first live account expanded from request and approval into budget, ToV, or venue sourcing.

After 12 months, you will have:

  • One customer closing a full ToV reporting cycle in Onomi 360 instead of Excel.
  • Three accounts running request to closure in production, and the org-wide calendar or HCP engagement view used outside compliance.
  • Onomi 360 winning the meetings-management scope in RFPs.

What you need to be great at

  • Life-sciences meetings, compliance, or transparency operations. You have built or operated workflows spanning approval, budgeting, ToV, and closure, and you know what EFPIA and Sunshine disclosure mean in practice.
  • HCP data and integration fluency. Identity across Veeva, Salesforce, OneKey, and NPI; match rates; what a data team expects from a write-back.
  • Domain-to-product translation. A messy operating process becomes states, rules, configuration, permissions, and audit events, with regulation separated from customer policy.
  • Sequencing. The smallest production slice that proves the model without hiding the hard architectural or compliance question.
  • Bias to execute. You ship, prototype, and put things in front of users in days, not spend weeks describing the problem. You drive decisions to a close and pull others along.
  • Precise writing and direct communication. Specs detailed enough to build and review, plain words, disagreement in the open.
  • Technical and AI fluency. You work in Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, you understand code, data flows, and architecture well enough to challenge an engineering design. You know the software development lifecycle deeply, from RFC and specification through review, release, and support. AI takes you from evidence to a testable artifact in hours.

What we want to hear about

  1. Life-sciences meetings and transfer of value. Tell us about a meetings or transfer-of-value process you built or ran end to end, from request through approval, budget, HCP registration, and disclosure. Where did it break, and what did you change? This is the process Onomi 360 replaces, and we want someone who has lived it.
  2. From operating process to product. Tell us about a messy process you turned into a product: which rules you made fixed, which you made configurable, what you integrated, and what you left manual. That translation is the heart of this role.
  3. Shipping fast. Tell us about the last thing you shipped or prototyped within two weeks of first hearing the problem. What did you skip, and what did users do with it? Here you put working software in front of pharma design partners every few weeks, not slides.
  4. Building with AI. Tell us about something you built yourself with Claude Code or another AI tool that changed a product decision, and what it taught you about the code or the architecture underneath. AI-assisted development is how we build, and you will have real freedom to use it.

Fluent English (written and spoken). Remote, based in Europe or in the US Eastern or Central time zones, with about 10-20 % travel to design partners and industry events.

SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status.

raw.title: DSP Designer
raw.excerpt: Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose.
raw.description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The DSP Designer plays a key role in developing and delivering complex signal processing algorithms for Fidus clients, from concept through simulation, fixed-point implementation, and hardware bring-up. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus FPGA/hardware teams to design algorithms, perform quantization and bit-width analysis, and translate DSP concepts into feasible hardware architectures.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys moving between application domains (communications, radar/sensing, industrial, medical), is comfortable working across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary, and takes pride in producing well-documented, bit-true designs.

Make an Impact with US:

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across communications, Aerospace & Defense, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, Medical Devices, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop and simulate DSP algorithms (equalization, filtering, estimation, detection) in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python, from concept through fixed-point validation
  • Perform quantization/bit-width analysis and produce bit-true fixed-point models suitable for HDL implementation
  • Collaborate with FPGA/HDL and hardware teams to translate algorithms into feasible hardware architectures (pipelining, MAC/resource budgeting, timing closure)
  • Support HDL verification through golden-model test vectors and co-simulation
  • Support lab bring-up, characterization, and tuning of DSP-based hardware against real-world channel/sensor behavior
  • Adapt existing DSP toolkits to new client domains and standards across multiple engagements (e.g., communications, Aerospace & Defense, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, Medical Devices, and Semiconductor)
  • Document algorithm design decisions, trade-offs, and validation results for client and internal reference

Who You are:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or related field
  • Strong foundation in signals and systems: Fourier/Z-transform, digital filter design (FIR/IIR), sampling theory
  • Practical experience with estimation/detection theory (e.g., matched filtering, MMSE, Kalman filtering) or adaptive filtering (LMS/RLS)
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python for algorithm design and simulation
  • Experience with fixed-point conversion and quantization trade-off analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary (collaborating directly with HDL/FPGA teams)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills - ability to explain algorithm trade-offs to non-DSP stakeholders
  • Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in one or more of: optical/wireless communications, radar/sensing, motor control, biomedical signal processing, semiconductor test
  • Experience with high-speed SerDes and PAM4 signaling (e.g., PCIe Gen6, 400G/800G Ethernet electrical) - equalization (FFE/CTLE/DFE), link training, and FEC awareness
  • Familiarity with AMD's Adaptive Computing portfolio (Versal, Alveo) or embedded x86 product lines
  • Familiarity with HDL Coder, HLS, or Simulink-to-HDL co-simulation workflows
  • Hands-on lab experience (scope, VNA, BERT, or domain-equivalent test equipment)
  • Exposure to safety-critical or regulated development processes (DO-178C/DO-254, ISO 26262, IEC 62304/60601) - valued for A&D, automotive, and medtech engagements specifically
  • Experience adapting quickly across multiple industries or client domains (consulting/services background a plus)
  • Exposure to AI/ML techniques applied to signal processing on FPGAs, GPUs, NPUs, or CPUs
  • Experience with dedicated DSP processors (e.g., Analog Devices, Texas Instruments)
  • Experience with RF front-end systems and data converter interfaces (ADC/DAC), including digital up/down-conversion (DUC/DDC)

Location and travel: Fully remote role and requires around 15% travel, including domestic and international.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k) contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

Our work spans space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video and imaging, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. We are not tied to a single product or industry—our work follows the technology, not just one roadmap.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can't wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our Working at Fidus page.

Fidus has a commitment to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process. Automated tools (including AI) support our initial screening of applicants against our job posting to identify candidates whose qualifications, experience, and skills align most closely with the position requirements. All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Thank you for your interest in Fidus. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Fidus is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Job Title: In-House Clinical Research Associate I - Poland - Remote

Job Location: Warsaw, Mazowieckie, Poland

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Seniority Level:

Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What Clinical Operations Site Management does at Worldwide

Embark on a fulfilling Clinical Operations career as you leave a lasting impact on patients’ lives. Join Worldwide Clinical Trials for an unparalleled CRO experienced, where you can drive extraordinary scientific breakthroughs and contribute to the very heart of every successful clinical trial.

Working alongside brilliant minds across a variety of therapeutic areas, you will have the chance to collaborate closely with top-tier colleagues from diverse backgrounds and specialties. Our commitment to advancing clinical research is cultivated in a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with our hands-on leadership and dedicated team members working together to innovate and solve complex challenges for our customers.

What you will do

  • Ensure quality of data submitted from study sites and assure timely submission of data, including appropriate reporting and follow-up for all safety events by site personnel

  • Ensure completeness and compile regulatory documents and ethical submission documentation as appropriate and required (e.g. IRB approval, informed consent, lab certification etc.)

  • Provide applicable updates for site related documentation for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF)

  • Perform feasibility studies/site identification activities for potential sites, as requested

What you will bring to the role

  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills

  • Ability to contribute to a team remotely

  • Strong customer focus, ability to interact professionally with a sponsor contact

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CTMS, and EDC Systems

Your background

  • Four-year college curriculum with a major concentration in life science preferred but not required, OR

  • Two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training and one year experience with clinical research (e.g. study coordinator, CTA, etc.) or other experience deemed relevant

  • Proficiency in English and Polish and one other language ( German, French, Italian, Spanish )

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. raw.title: Tax Accountant (Corporate & VAT) - UK
raw.excerpt: GoGlobal is establishing an in-house UK corporate tax and VAT capability to support a growing portfolio of clients.
raw.description:
GoGlobal is establishing an in-house UK corporate tax and VAT capability to support a growing portfolio of clients. The role combines hands-on tax compliance delivery with technical support to the business-development process.

The postholder prepares and reviews UK Corporation Tax and VAT returns and files them with HMRC to deadline, while maintaining the supporting accounting records. In addition, the postholder provides technical tax input to the sales process, including scoping client requirements, estimating effort and supporting proposals and pricing, and advises clients across corporate tax and VAT.

The role sits within the Accounting, Tax & Payments function and reports to the Regional Product Owner (EMEA). Two positions are available, at Senior and Junior level, to provide cover, resilience and a route for progression. The working language is English and no additional language is required, giving access to a broad candidate pool from UK practice and industry.

GoGlobal acts as its clients’ UK tax agent, and is registered with HMRC and supervised for anti-money-laundering purposes in accordance with HMRC’s Standard for Agents. The postholder operates within this framework.

Roles & Responsibilities

Corporate Tax Compliance

• Prepare and review UK Corporation Tax returns (CT600) and computations, including iXBRL tagging, and file them with HMRC to deadline.

• Address capital allowances, tax adjustments to the accounts, loss and group relief, and Research & Development claims where relevant.

• Manage Corporation Tax payment deadlines, including Quarterly Instalment Payments for larger companies.

VAT Compliance

• Prepare and review VAT returns under Making Tax Digital (MTD) and file them with HMRC to deadline.

• Manage VAT registrations and de-registrations, and advise on schemes and treatments, including flat-rate, partial exemption, and place-of-supply and cross-border matters.

• Manage VAT deadlines, payments and reconciliations across the client portfolio.

Accounting and Statutory

• Prepare and review statutory accounts under UK GAAP (FRS 102 / FRS 105) and management accounts in support of the tax work.

• Support Companies House filings, including annual accounts and the confirmation statement, and maintain statutory records.

Business Development Support

• Provide technical tax input to the sales process, including scoping client requirements, estimating effort and supporting proposals and pricing.

• Represent the tax function in client and prospective-client meetings, presenting GoGlobal’s UK capability accurately and credibly.

• Identify opportunities to extend GoGlobal services (entity management, payroll, accounting and Employer of Record) within the client portfolio.

• Contribute to service documentation, scoping templates and technical guidance for UK tax.

Client Relationship and Advisory

• Manage the relationships within an assigned client portfolio and provide proactive, practical UK tax and accounting advice.

• Resolve client queries and issues promptly, and communicate technical matters clearly and commercially.

HMRC, Controls and Quality

• Manage HMRC correspondence, agent authorisations (form 64-8), enquiries and filing calendars.

• Apply four-eyes review, GoGlobal internal controls and data-protection standards, and operate within anti-money-laundering requirements and HMRC’s Standard for Agents.

Key Performance Indicators

• Corporation Tax, VAT and statutory-accounts filings completed accurately and on time, with no missed HMRC or Companies House deadlines.

• Contribution to business development, measured through proposals supported and new or extended work won.

• Client satisfaction and retention across the portfolio.

• Turnaround times and quality of work, including levels of rework.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

• Qualified in UK corporate tax and VAT: ATT (Association of Taxation Technicians), or qualified by experience in corporate tax and VAT compliance.

• No statutory licence is required in the United Kingdom to prepare or file Corporation Tax or VAT returns. A chartered-accountant qualification (ACA or ACCA) or CPA is not required, as this is a tax role rather than an audit role.

• CTA (Chartered Tax Adviser) is desirable, particularly for the Senior position. Candidates for the Junior position may be ATT-qualified or part-qualified and studying.

• GoGlobal provides the anti-money-laundering supervision and HMRC agent registration; the postholder is expected to meet fit-and-proper standards and to work within HMRC’s Standard for Agents.

Core Requirements

• Practical working knowledge of UK Corporation Tax (CT600, computations and iXBRL) and VAT (MTD), together with UK GAAP (FRS 102 / FRS 105).

• Familiarity with HMRC online services, Making Tax Digital and Companies House filings, and competence with tax and accounting software (for example Alphatax, Digita, CCH, TaxCalc, Xero or Sage).

• Commercial awareness and a client-facing manner, with the confidence to support business development through scoping, pricing and client meetings.

• Strong written and spoken English, and a well-organised, accurate and deadline-driven approach.

• The right to work in the United Kingdom.

Preferred

• Experience in practice (an accountancy or tax firm) managing a portfolio of clients, ideally including international or foreign-owned entities.

• Exposure to payroll and PAYE, Research & Development relief, or cross-border and international tax.

• Experience contributing to proposals, pricing or business development, and with cloud accounting software such as Xero.

Who Thrives in This Role

• Technically strong tax professionals who are also commercially minded and comfortable supporting business development.

• Client-facing advisers who enjoy variety across corporate tax, VAT and accounting, and managing a growing portfolio.

• Clear communicators who can make technical matters simple and useful for clients.

Benefits

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.
    • We do not offer equity plans. As we are not for sale and are not chasing an exit, "stock options" hold little value in our business model. Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout.
    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.
    • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

Ready to take the next step in your career with us? Apply now!

**Kindly review the provided privacy notice (LINK) to gain a comprehensive understanding of our policies and practices governing the treatment of your Personal Data. By applying, you consent to background and reference checks, to the extent permissible by law.

Company Description

To apply for this position, you must be a U.S. Citizen, you must currently live in the U.S., you must pass an FBI background check, and you must be willing to take a drug test.

ForceMetrics™ mission is to transform data for social change. We’re striving to make a positive community impact by helping public safety and government agencies better utilize data to benefit every individual. By bringing data-driven innovation to dated systems and processes, ForceMetrics is empowering responders to make better, more informed decisions in the moment, ultimately working to solve some of the toughest societal problems.

About the role

HOW YOU WILL HAVE IMPACT

  • Work directly with customers and field users to surface problems worth solving and see them through to delivery.
  • Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Go-To-Market teams to shape and execute the product roadmap.
  • Translate product strategy into clear user stories and detailed requirements that deliver customer value.
  • Take features from zero to one, including ideation, research, development, and successful launch.
  • Enable go-to-market readiness through collaboration with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Write user stories and functional specs based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
  • Run discovery sessions, conduct user interviews, and review customer feedback to validate product direction.
  • Partner with product and leadership teams to help define the product roadmap and prioritize impactful initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Engineering on timelines and deliverables.
  • Communicate product vision and updates through wireframes, presentations, and internal documentation.
  • Support the evaluation, integration, and onboarding of new datasets and third-party APIs into the platform.
  • Coordinate launches with internal stakeholders and ensure readiness across GTM functions.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer within cross-functional teams.

Requirements

WHAT YOU MUST HAVE

  • Domain experience: 3 to 5 years in a Product Manager role within a SaaS company, ideally in public safety, law enforcement, govtech, or a data-intensive product environment, or direct experience as a law enforcement professional, crime analyst, or public safety practitioner ready to transition into product.
  • Data fluency: You've worked with data in a meaningful way, whether building data products, working with APIs and integrations, or using data operationally to make decisions in the field.
  • Startup experience: You've worked in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where ambiguity is the norm and execution is the expectation.
  • Small team success: You're energized by working on a focused, cross-functional team. You contribute directly, take ownership, and move things forward alongside your teammates.
  • Hands-on mindset: You roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and move things forward without waiting for perfect conditions.
  • End-to-end expertise: You've conducted research, built requirements, and successfully shipped products.
  • Exceptional communication: You can clearly articulate priorities and requirements to both technical teams and leadership.
  • Problem-solving skills: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, prioritizing ruthlessly, and using creative thinking to move forward.
  • Comfort with iterative development: You've worked in sprint-based environments and understand how to ship incrementally.

Benefits

WHAT WE CAN OFFER

  • A strong sense of mission for impacting real communities and solving complex societal problems
  • Work alongside other top talent in a rewarding and enjoyable culture
  • Company Equity (seed-state)
  • Medical, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance
  • 401(k)
  • 100% Remote
  • Standard holidays and paid time off
  • Salary range for this position is Base Salary of $105K to $130K+ DOE

About ForceMetrics

ForceMetrics was founded in 2020 to provide data analytics and enrichment applications to public safety agencies throughout the United States, with a focus on better community outcomes through data.

We're venture-backed with a diverse founding team led by Andre McGregor, computer engineer and veteran FBI Special Agent turned entrepreneur, alongside a team of data scientists, software engineers, cybersecurity experts, and business operations leaders—many of whom have been law enforcement officers themselves, and have previously built successful companies.

We have a robust set of investors and an advisory board of active/retired police chiefs, government leaders, and technology innovators.

ForceMetrics™ values diversity, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. ForceMetrics™ will not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind based on any characteristics.

Join the growing team at Next Job Abroad!

We're looking for an experienced German-speaking recruiter to join our international team on a freelance basis.

This role is for someone who already understands recruitment. You should have previous experience from agency recruitment, international recruitment or another fast-paced recruitment environment where sourcing, candidate management, KPIs and placements are part of your everyday work.

You'll have plenty of support from the team, but we're looking for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of their own desk and driving their own results.

About the Role

As an International Freelance Recruiter, you'll manage your own candidate pipeline and recruit primarily for language-based roles across Europe.

You'll be expected to work proactively, understand where your candidates need to come from and take responsibility for moving your recruitment processes forward.

During your first three months, you'll receive a monthly onboarding bonus, while learning our clients, processes and tools. After this period, the role continues on a commission basis with no earning cap.

You should be comfortable dedicating around 30-40 hours per week to the role, as this is what will be needed to be successful in the role.

What You'll Do

  • Source and headhunt German-speaking candidates across Europe
  • Recruit candidates in English for other language-based positions
  • Screen CVs and conduct candidate interviews
  • Assess motivation, suitability and relocation readiness
  • Manage candidates throughout the recruitment process
  • Build and maintain your own candidate pipeline
  • Work proactively towards weekly and monthly KPIs
  • Collaborate with the team on client requirements and open positions
  • Follow up with candidates throughout onboarding and after placement

Requirements

You:

  • Speak German at native or near-native level
  • Have a strong level of English
  • Have previous professional recruitment experience
  • Ideally come from agency recruitment, international recruitment or high-volume recruitment
  • Have hands-on experience with sourcing and headhunting
  • Are comfortable working towards KPIs, targets and placements
  • Know how to manage and prioritise your own recruitment pipeline
  • Are highly self-motivated and don't need someone else to constantly tell you what to do next
  • Take ownership when something isn't working and actively look for another approach
  • Are comfortable working independently in a performance-driven environment

This Role Will Suit You If...

You like having freedom and responsibility in equal measure.

We don't micromanage, but that also means you'll need to be comfortable taking the wheel yourself, planning your activity, following up with candidates, adjusting your sourcing strategy and understanding what needs to happen to reach your targets.

If you're used to agency recruitment and enjoy the satisfaction of turning your own pipeline into placements, you'll probably feel at home here.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Monthly onboarding bonus and training during your first 3 months
  • Uncapped commission after the initial period
  • Fully remote freelance setup (within EU)
  • Flexibility to manage your own working day
  • Clear KPIs and expectations
  • International recruitment projects across Europe
  • Supportive and collaborative recruiter team
  • Opportunity for long-term collaboration and development

raw.description:
About Paired

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent!

We are dedicated to connecting talented individuals with remarkable companies in need of their skills. Our goal is to create fulfilling job opportunities for professionals around the world.

About our Client

They're a direct-to-consumer subscription brand that has gone from zero to a multiple nine-figure run rate in under three years — completely bootstrapped, with a small, lean team spread across the globe. No outside capital, no board, no bureaucracy. We sell across our own D2C site, Amazon, and TikTok Shop, with a subscription retention engine underneath it all.

They grew fast enough that structure never caught up with scale. That is the problem this role exists to solve.

The role

The CEO currently has roughly 25 people, agencies, and suppliers reporting to him across Customer Service, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Operations, Retention, and Finance — plus a running list of ~20 ad hoc growth projects. There is no layer between him and the work. Every decision, follow-up, deadline, blocker, and loose thread routes to one inbox.

The Chief of Staff is that layer. You will own the operating system of the company: who owns what, how they're measured, what they committed to, and whether it actually happened. You'll also own a rotating portfolio of high-leverage projects end to end, and you'll handle the CEO's calendar, inbox, and meeting follow-up so his time goes to product, partnerships, and P&L.

This is not a coordination job. You are expected to get into the weeds, do the work yourself, push people, and raise the standard. You start reporting directly to the CEO with influence rather than formal authority — and as you prove you can handle it, you'll be given the authority to escalate, reassign, and put underperformers on a plan.

Where this goes: if you crush this role, the path is C-suite or President within two years. That is a real offer, not a recruiting line.

What You'll Do

  • Own accountability and urgency across every function. Each person and agency has KPIs, deadlines, and commitments. You track them, follow up individually, unblock what's stuck, enforce urgency, and make sure the owner knows they own the outcome. Functions include TikTok Shop (8 people), Amazon (agency of 5), Operations (3 suppliers, 3 in-house), Retention (email agency, in-house dev, media buyer), and Finance (3 in-house, 1 agency).
  • Build the process map of the entire business. Every role titled and defined, every responsibility documented, every recurring workflow written up as an SOP, every doc and tracker findable, a clear reporting and ownership structure, and clear written criteria for how someone earns a bonus, earns a promotion, or gets let go.
  • Triage everything currently flowing to the CEO. For each item: handle it yourself, route it to the right manager, automate it, or kill it. The goal is that it stops reaching him.
  • Own high-leverage projects end to end. You'll be handed ad hoc projects — growth initiatives, new channel tests, vendor negotiations, systems builds — with a goal and little else. You scope them, run them, hire or coordinate whoever is needed, and report meaningful progress in a weekly check-in without being managed step by step.
  • Turn conversations into tracked action. Sit in on calls, capture decisions and action items from meetings, Slack, and WhatsApp, assign owners and dates, and chase them to done.
  • Run the CEO's calendar, inbox, and meeting prep. Full ownership — scheduling, prioritization, prep material, follow-up.
  • Raise the bar on the people around you. Give direct feedback, flag underperformance early, and help managers hold their own teams accountable rather than doing it for them forever.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Demonstrated ability to learn fast and independently. If we hand you ClickUp on a Friday and say "know it by Monday," you find YouTube tutorials, book a consultant call, and figure it out yourself in a few hours. We don't care what tools you've used — we care that you can teach yourself anything.
  • You're smart and hands-on. You need to reason through complex business problems and handle people well enough that they want to deliver for you.
  • Genuine humility. Zero ego. You take direct feedback well, ask for more of it, and are never "above" the work. If a spreadsheet needs cleaning at 11 PM, you clean it.
  • Willingness to do the work yourself. This role manages and executes. Delegating without getting your hands dirty is a disqualifier.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and total ownership. Given a problem in a domain you know nothing about, your reaction is excitement, not fear.
  • Directness. You give and receive blunt feedback without it becoming personal or political.
  • Real work capacity. This is a 50-hour minimum role with frequent nights and weekends. We're a startup that moves quickly and we're honest about what that costs.
  • Availability during US Eastern hours within the 9:00 AM – 12:00 AM ET window.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice-to-have

  • A track record of excellence in a competitive environment. Top marks academically, a strong university, high-level competitive sports or esports, elite early-career roles, a company you built — something that shows you've been in a room full of winners and held your own.
  • E-commerce experience — D2C, Amazon, or TikTok Shop especially.
  • Subscription or retention business experience.
  • Prior Chief of Staff, founder's associate, consulting, or investment banking background.
  • Experience building SOPs, process documentation, or operating cadences from scratch.
  • Experience managing agencies and offshore contractors.

Note on weighting: soft skills outrank hard skills here. A candidate with less e-commerce experience but smart, hands on, humble, faster learning speed, and a stronger record of excellence beats a domain expert who's rigid or ego-driven. Hire for the athlete.

Benefits

  • Base: $6,000 – $8,000 USD/month, depending on experience (negotiable for the right fit!)
  • Bonus: 20% of base annually, tied to project completion and KPI attainment
  • Structure: W-2 or 1099 — your choice
  • Remote: Work from anywhere, as long as you cover Eastern hours
  • Growth: Direct, stated path to C-suite or President within two years for the right performer

The Culture

They move fast, communicate directly, and don't sugarcoat feedback. There are no politics, no vanity titles, and no tenure — you don't get status here for having been around. You keep what you kill: results drive promotions, bonuses, and authority.

Everyone here holds absurdly high standards for themselves and the people around them, and the standard keeps going up. Good is never the finish line. If that sounds exhausting, this isn't the right fit. If it sounds like the environment you've been looking for, it's rare that you get it at this scale with this little bureaucracy.

EBSCO Information Services (EBSCO) delivers a fully optimized research experience, seamlessly integrated with a powerful discovery platform to support the information needs and maximize the research experience of our end-users. Headquartered in Ipswich, MA, EBSCO employs more than 2,700 people worldwide, with most embracing hybrid or remote work models. As an AI-enabled service leader, we thrive on innovation, forward-thinking strategies, and the dedication of our exceptional team. At EBSCO, we’re driven to inspire, empower and support research. Our mission is to transform lives by providing reliable and relevant information — when, where and how people need it. We’re seeking dynamic, creative individuals whose diverse perspectives will help us achieve this global, inclusive mission. Join us to help make an impact.

Your Opportunity

As an E-Content Specialist, your primary responsibility is to help build and maintain a comprehensive, high-quality Global Knowledge Base (GKB), a centralized system that stores and manages metadata about electronic resources to ensure accurate linking to full text, to support customer needs. You will accomplish this by establishing quality data feeds with external data partners, analyzing and manipulating metadata for inclusion in the GKB, and taking ownership of identifying, adding, and maintaining all necessary collections to ensure their full and accurate representation. Additionally, you will resolve internal and external reported issues in a timely manner by applying strong research and critical-thinking skills, conducting root-cause analysis to identify trends, and implementing proactive solutions to reduce reoccurring issues.

This remote position is U.S.-based only (excluding U.S. territories).

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with global providers, using effective written and verbal communication to resolve data issues and obtain the metadata required for GKB maintenance.
  • Analyze publisher‑supplied metadata to ensure it is complete, high‑quality, and accurate, proactively identifying gaps and taking action to remediate them.
  • Create, load, and maintain collections in the GKB, managing associated metadata including descriptions, subject classifications, alternate names, and related attributes to support accurate indexing and discovery.
  • Develop and maintain internal documentation that describes how metadata should be transformed and manipulated for loading.
  • Research and source required metadata when it is not provided, ensuring it is properly structured and successfully loaded into the GKB.
  • Prioritize and manage weekly tasks, reporting progress and concerns in daily team workload meetings.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members and cross‑functional partners to meet individual, team, and organizational goals.

Your Team

You will be welcomed as a member of the Global Knowledge Base Team (a team of about 30 people) and the larger Product Management organization. Our team enjoys the flexibility and greater work life balance working remotely offers. There will be ample resources, tools, training, and support to ensure your success as an E-Content Specialist and your developme

About You

  • 2+ years of experience working with large datasets, metadata, or electronic resources
  • 2+ years of experience coordinating with third‑party vendors and managing high‑volume written and verbal communications
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to use VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and advanced functions/formulas, as well as experience working with datasets exceeding 50,000 rows

What Sets You Apart

  • Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills; technologically savvy
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and priorities, providing regular status updates and meeting deadlines in a remote work setting
  • Fast learner who adapts well to changing priorities
  • Proven attention to detail, maintaining high data quality standards (e.g., minimal error rates, consistent formatting, accurate classifications)
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, PowerPoint, Access, OneNote, Word, and SharePoint
  • Experience with metadata standards (e.g., KBART, MARC, Dublin Core, ONIX)

Pay Range

USD $50,790.00 - USD $72,555.00 /Yr.

Position Overview

The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for driving revenue growth within a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, primarily organizations with annual revenues exceeding $3 million. This role serves as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, leveraging deep expertise in Association Management Software (AMS) and the broader Momentive Software portfolio to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and expand customer partnerships.


The Enterprise Account Executive owns the full sales cycle and executes an expanded selling motion across multiple product lines, partnering cross-functionally to deliver measurable customer outcomes and long-term value.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own and manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise
  • Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies designed to drive retention, expansion, and net new revenue growth.
  • Lead the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, and close.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive and senior-level stakeholders within customer organizations.

  • Consistently achieve or exceed assigned bookings, expansion, and retention targets.
  • Track and achieve necessary core metrics and KPI's (daily, monthly, quarterly)
  • Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual goals set by management

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of successful B2B sales experience, preferably within SaaS environments, with a demonstrated history of exceeding quota attainment.
  • Proven success managing complex enterprise accounts and executing consultative sales strategies.
  • Experience selling into organizations with sophisticated stakeholder groups and extended sales cycles.
  • Strong expertise in Association Management Software (AMS) solutions and the association or nonprofit sector preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to expand existing customer relationships through cross-sell and upsell motions across multiple product offerings.
  • Experience engaging executive-level buyers and presenting business cases to senior leadership teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Highly self-motivated, strategic, and results-oriented with strong business acumen.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce, Gong, Claude, proficient in Office 365 plus related sales technologies.
  • Strong financial and business acumen with the ability to quantify business impact and ROI.

  • Experience coordinating complex deal strategies across cross-functional teams.
  • Deep understanding of SaaS solutions and ability to align product capabilities with enterprise-level customer needs

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. Job Overview:

The Executive Director, IT Strategy & Operations is a senior IT leadership position responsible for translating SMPA's technology strategy into coordinated priorities, investments, operating plans, and measurable business outcomes.

Reporting directly to the Vice President, Head of Data & Information Technology, this executive serves as the principal strategy and execution partner under the direction of the VP of IT and leads the connective operating functions that enable IT to perform as one integrated enterprise partner.

The role will establish and lead disciplined operating practices across IT strategy execution, portfolio governance, business analysis, project and program delivery, IT financial planning, IT procurement coordination, and vendor performance oversight, in partnership with functional IT leaders, Finance, Procurement, and the VP of IT. The role will ensure that business demand, technology investment, resource capacity, delivery execution, and value realization are aligned to SMPA's enterprise priorities and Boost 2028 commitments.

This is a leadership role with clearly delegated authority to strengthen accountability, resolve cross-functional barriers, improve decision quality, and increase the organization’s capacity to execute.

Essential Functions Required for Job

Strategy, Planning and Operating Model

  • Translate SMPA’s enterprise priorities into a technology strategy, multi-year roadmap, annual operating plan, and prioritized investment agenda with clear business outcomes, ownership, funding, and success measures.
  • Advise the VP of IT on strategic priorities, organizational design, investment tradeoffs, and execution risks while strengthening decision rights, governance, cross-functional processes, and accountability.
  • Serve as the VP of IT’s designated delegate for defined forums, decisions, and operating cadences when the VP is unavailable or explicitly delegates authority.

Portfolio Governance and Delivery

  • Lead the IT PMO and portfolio management discipline, providing an integrated view of priorities, investments, milestones, financial performance, resources, risks, and dependencies.
  • Lead and manage demand intake and prioritization to ensure business needs are clearly defined, solution options are evaluated, and resources are focused on the initiatives with the greatest enterprise value.
  • Strengthen delivery discipline & rigor, stabilize at-risk initiatives, and identify, escalate, and help resolve cross-functional barriers to accelerate execution and value realization.

IT Financial Management, Procurement and Vendor Governance

  • Support IT budgeting, forecasting, investment governance, cost transparency, procurement, and strategic sourcing in partnership with Finance and functional IT leaders.
  • Optimize technology spend, contracts, renewals, vendor performance, and total cost of ownership while strengthening commercial discipline and internal accountability.

Executive Reporting and Performance Management

  • Deliver decision-ready portfolio, financial, risk, and performance insights to the VP of IT, leadership team, and business stakeholders.
  • Establish performance measures that connect technology investments, process improvements, and delivery results to measurable business outcomes, financial stewardship, and stakeholder confidence.

Organizational Leadership and Enterprise Transformation

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary organization spanning strategy, portfolio management, program delivery, IT business operations, IT finance, IT procurement, and vendor management.
  • Deploy team capabilities against SMPA’s highest-priority needs while maintaining flexibility to evolve roles, responsibilities, and operating structures as business requirements change.
  • Lead cross-functional transformation, process modernization, and operating-model improvements that strengthen organizational performance, adoption, and sustainable business value.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (general & technical):

Strategy And Enterprise Perspective

  • Exceptional enterprise and strategic thinking, with the ability to translate business priorities into actionable technology strategies, investment plans, operating models, and measurable outcomes.
  • High degree of organizational awareness and systems thinking, with the ability to connect complex interdependencies across business functions, technology teams, investments, vendors, risks, and enterprise priorities.

Executive Influence and Operating Model Leadership

  • Strong executive presence and influence, with demonstrated ability to advise senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, build alignment, and drive decisions across organizational boundaries.
  • Proven ability to design and lead enterprise operating models, governance frameworks, decision rights, management cadences, and accountability structures.

Portfolio, Investment and Financial Management

  • Advanced portfolio and investment-management capabilities, including prioritization, capacity planning, risk management, financial oversight, dependency management, and value realization.
  • Strong financial and business acumen, with the ability to evaluate business cases, budgets, forecasts, vendor proposals, contracts, total cost of ownership, and investment tradeoffs.

Transformation And Problem Solving

  • Demonstrated transformation and change-leadership capabilities, including organizational redesign, process modernization, capability development, stakeholder engagement, and adoption.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous business needs, identify root causes, evaluate solution options, and recommend practical courses of action.

About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

Position Summary

The VP, Application Managed Service Delivery is a high-impact executive leadership role for a proven operator who can scale a global Application Managed Services business while improving profitability, client value, and delivery excellence. You will own the AMS function end to end, lead a globally distributed organization, and shape how services are designed, sold, delivered, measured, and continuously improved. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial and operational instincts with the ability to modernize delivery through process discipline, automation, AI, tooling, organizational design, and service innovation.

  • Own a strategic global services business with direct influence on growth, client outcomes, and margin performance.
  • Lead the transformation of delivery through operational rigor, technology enablement, and scalable service innovation.
  • Partner across Sales, Professional Services, Product, Support, and other leadership teams to shape differentiated offerings and market success.

You will be expected to build a high-performing organization, elevate the economics of the business, and help define the next generation of managed services offerings for the company and its clients.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead the global Application Managed Services organization with full accountability for strategy, operating model, service delivery, organizational performance, and business results.
  • Improve profitability and scalability by simplifying delivery, optimizing cost structure, increasing productivity, and strengthening operational discipline.
  • Modernize service delivery through automation, AI-enabled capabilities, tooling, standard processes, and innovative delivery techniques.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team and leadership bench across a global, matrixed environment.
  • Define and manage the metrics that matter, including business health, service performance, client satisfaction, workforce effectiveness, revenue, and margin.
  • Create compelling ways to demonstrate customer value through business outcomes, efficiency gains, risk reduction, and strategic impact—not just service-level compliance.
  • Partner closely with Professional Services to create a roadmap for transforming selected project-based offerings into scalable managed services solutions.
  • Work with the Sales organization to enable effective positioning, messaging, and commercialization of AMS offerings.
  • Help shape, package, and launch new services that align with market demand and company strategy.
  • Represent the AMS business in client-facing conversations, strategic pursuits, and executive-level cross-functional planning.
  • Stay ahead of market trends and emerging technologies, translating relevant innovation into practical business value.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) required; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.

Location

  • United States (remote, with travel as required)

Experience

  • 15+ years of leadership experience in application managed services, enterprise application services, ERP services, or a closely related environment.
  • A track record of owning a delivery organization or business unit with responsibility for service quality, client outcomes, and financial performance.
  • Demonstrated success improving margins through cost optimization, process transformation, automation, or operating model redesign.
  • Experience implementing or scaling delivery-enabling platforms, tooling, or AI-driven capabilities.
  • Strength in executive-level customer engagement, strategic account leadership, and cross-functional influence.
  • Experience leading globally distributed teams and driving change in complex, matrixed organizations.

Desired Skills

  • Commercially minded and operationally rigorous, with the ability to balance growth, margin, delivery quality, and client success.
  • Skilled at designing scalable operating models and building repeatable, high-performing managed services organizations.
  • Able to connect innovation with execution, turning AI, automation, tooling, and process improvements into measurable business results.
  • Confident engaging senior client, sales, and executive stakeholders with credibility and influence.
  • Data-driven and outcome-oriented, with strong judgment and a bias for action.
  • An effective builder of teams, leaders, and cross-functional partnerships in dynamic global environments.

Why Rimini Street?

Rimini Street Inc. is an affirmative action-equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable Federal, State, and Local Laws regarding recruitment and hiring.

Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable Federal, State, or Local laws. Rimini Street Inc. offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to employees.

The general salary range for this type of role is 186k - 232k depending on skills and experience. The actual compensation offered will ultimately be based on several factors such as: a candidate's location, and the level of applicable skills and professional experience. Rimini’s target pay for each position is available upon request during the applicant’s Interview process.

Benefits for US employees include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Disability insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • 401(k) program
  • Generous Paid time off (PTO)

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

  • Company
    • We dream big and innovate boldly.
  • Colleagues
    • We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
  • Clients
    • We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service.
  • Community
    • We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth

  • Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017
  • Over 6,300+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
  • Over 2,000 team members in 23 countries
  • US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here:

Rimini Street is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

To learn more about how Rimini Street is redefining the enterprise software support industry, visit

Job Description

Required Certificates and Licenses

Salary: $51,000 plus the eligibility of a performance bonus

Start Date: School Year 2026/2027

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, Carolus Online Academy (COA). We want you to be a part of our talented team!

The mission of Carolus Online Academy (COA) is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

The Middle School Social Studies Teacher is a highly qualified, state certified educator responsible for delivering specific course content in an online environment. Middle School Social Studies Teachers provide instruction, support, and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students’ individual needs. Middle School Social Studies Teachers monitor student progress through Stride K12’s learning management system. They actively work closely with students and parents/learning coaches to advance each student’s learning toward established goals. Middle School Social Studies Teachers typically work from home but must travel occasionally throughout the year to various school functions, such as state testing or as otherwise required by the school.

This is a full-time position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Provides rich and engaging synchronous and asynchronous learning experiences for students

  • Commitment to personalizing learning for all students

  • Demonstrates a belief in all students’ ability to succeed and meet high expectations

  • Differentiates instruction based on student level of mastery

  • Augments course content according to prescribed policies and procedures using appropriate asynchronous and synchronous tools under guidance from principal and coach

  • Maintains grade book ensuring student academic integrity, makes student placement and promotion decisions, and alerts administrators to concerns about student performance and progress

  • Prepares students for high stakes standardized tests

  • Understands that a primary responsibility is to establish and maintain positive rapport with families and regularly communicates with and responds to students and learning coaches/parents in a timely manner

  • Supports learning coaches/parents with student curricular and instructional issues, as well as basic troubleshooting in a virtual classroom environment that is in line with academy policies and procedures

  • Travels as required (on average once per month and/or approximately 20% of the time) for face-to-face professional development, student testing, and as required by school

REQUIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree AND

  • Active state teaching license AND

  • Ability to clear required background check

DESIRED QUALIFICATION:

  • Experience working with proposed age group.

  • Experience supporting adults and children in the use of technology.

  • Experience teaching in an online (virtual) and/or in a brick-and-mortar environment.

  • Experience with online learning platforms.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with otherteachers to interpretand produce numeric, tabular, and graphic representations of student data, and use it to drive instructional decisions.

  • Receptive to receiving coaching regularly with administrators and teacher trainers.

  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint.

  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms.

  • Ability to maintain teachercertification/professionaldevelopment hours and fluency in K12 systems, programs and curriculum.

Compensation & Benefits: Stride, Inc. considers a person’s education, experience, and qualifications, as well as the position’s work location, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value when determining a new employee’s salary level. Salaries will differ based on these factors, the position’s level and expected contribution, and the employee’s benefits elections. Offers will typically be in the bottom half of the range.

  • We anticipate the salary range to be $51,000. Eligible employees may receive a bonus. This salary is not guaranteed, as an individual’s compensation can vary based on several factors. These factors include, but are not limited to, geographic location, experience, training, education, and local market conditions. Stride offers a robust benefits package for eligible employees that can include health benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

Regular
